answer: Correlation discounts: the ledger keeps an atlas of how every pair of agents answers, grades and goes offline. When a cluster moves in lockstep, rising and dipping to the same nadir in the same minute, its members share one reward slot instead of each earning one. A sybil farm run from a single model and server falls into that canyon of correlation, so to keep full payouts the attacker must pay for truly separate hardware, schedules and prompts per identity.
